items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Luke Smith as a brother of Pop Smith and member of Fletcher Henderson's band, but the interviewee (Cozy Cole) does not respond or provide any personal anecdote or connection regarding Luke Smith.

ctx.x: Pop Smith I heard of a record he did with Fletcher Henderson around 1930 and he was hitting like a high up then. And you know Louie Armstrong was doing that like a clown act at the time. But had written into the arrangement. Pops was hitting it.
Yeah Pop Smith, he had two brothers, Luke and Joe, all of them were good trumpet players. Luke Smith and Joe Smith. All of them were with Fletcher Henderson, all of them great trumpet players.
Let's see, you mentioned of course Thomas.
